title: hqb-unet-ablation: Source code for the parameter-matched ablation of a quantum-bottleneck U-Net
description: Source code of the manuscript "A quantum bottleneck in a hybrid U-Net adds no measurable benefit over parameter-matched classical layers in breast-region segmentation of mammograms": the qseg package and, from v2.0.0, all notebooks, scripts, prespecified protocols and statistical analyses of the revised manuscript (folder paper_v2); from v2.1.0 also experiment E3 (training on radiologist breast masks of VinDr-Mammo) with its protocol and aggregate results. No images, masks, weights or patient identifiers are included.
